blocks.text: 1.5 Complex Numbers in the Real World (Voltage, Current and Resistance)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is heading ka number 1.5 likha hai, jo woh pehle hi "Four Fourth Roots of Unity" (kitab ka page 12) ke liye use kar chuki hai. Hum ne number kitab jaisa rakha hai taa ke aap kitab mein dhoond saken; ghalti sirf numbering mein hai.

Bohat se students poochhte hain: "Sir, imaginary numbers ka asal zindagi mein kya faida?" Is sabaq mein isi sawal ka jawab hai. Hum do jagahen dekhenge jahan complex numbers sach mein kaam aate hain: bijli ke AC circuits, aur cryptography (paighaam ko khufia code mein badalna). Dono mein wahi maths lagegi jo aap ne pichle topics mein seekhi: polar form mein divide (1.3.3), conjugate, aur multiplicative inverse.

Pehle Physics ki ek jaani pehchaani baat yaad kijiye. Ohm's Law physics ka ek bunyaadi usool hai jo electrical circuit mein voltage \(V\) (bijli ka dabaao), current \(I\) (bijli ka bahaao) aur resistance \(R\) (rukawat) ka rishta batata hai:
\[V = IR\]
Isay paani ke pipe se samjhiye: tanki ki oonchaai dabaao hai (voltage), pipe mein behta paani current hai, aur pipe ka patla hona rukawat hai (resistance). Dabaao zyada ho to bahaao zyada; rukawat zyada ho to bahaao kam.

Lekin ghar ki bijli DC nahi, AC (alternating current) hoti hai, jo har second mein kayi baar apni direction badalti hai. AC circuits mein resistance ka tasawwur phail kar impedance \(Z\) ban jaata hai. Circuit mein inductor (taar ka coil) aur capacitor bhi rukawat dalte hain; inhein reactance kehte hain, \(X_L\) (inductor ka) aur \(X_C\) (capacitor ka). Dono ka farq kul reactance hai:
\[X = X_L - X_C\]
Geometry mein yeh saath wali figure ki tarah dikhaya jaata hai. Yahan
\[Z = R + iX\]
yaani resistance real part hai aur reactance imaginary part. Phir AC circuits ke liye Ohm's Law impedance ki shakal mein yeh hai:
\[V = I \cdot Z\]

blocks.alt: Right triangle with the right angle at the bottom right: horizontal base R, vertical side labelled X = (X_L) minus (X_C), and the slanting side Z.
blocks.caption: Figure: the impedance triangle, Z = R + iX (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai "Resistance in a circuit is due to inductor \((X_L)\) and capacitor \((X_C)\)". Inductor aur capacitor ki wajah se hone wali rukawat ko reactance (\(X_L\) aur \(X_C\)) kehte hain, resistance nahi. Resistance \(R\) resistors aur taaron se aata hai. Impedance \(Z = R + iX\) dono ko mila deta hai, bilkul jaisa kitab ki figure dikhati hai. Upar humne sahi baat likhi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yahan complex numbers aaye hi kyun? AC circuit mein resistance ka asar aur reactance ka asar ek doosre se chauthai cycle (\(90^{\circ}\)) aage peeche hote hain, bilkul jaise real aur imaginary axes aapas mein right angle par hain. Is liye resistance ko real axis par aur reactance ko imaginary axis par rakh dete hain: \(Z = R + iX\). Ab figure wala triangle samajh aata hai:
• Kul rukawat ka size modulus hai: \(|Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X^2}\) (triangle mein Pythagoras).
• Us ka angle \(\tan^{-1}(X/R)\) hai.
• Polar form mein \(Z = |Z|(\cos\varphi + i\sin\varphi)\), aur phir \(V = IZ\) ek multiplication ban jaata hai aur \(I = V/Z\) ek division: bilkul 1.3.3 wale polar rules.
Ek dilchasp baat: engineers \(i\) ki jagah \(j\) likhte hain, kyun ke \(I\) (ya \(i\)) pehle hi current ke liye istemaal hota hai. Kitab ki misaal mein bhi yahi uljhan nazar aayegi.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Kitab ki misaal se pehle ek chhoti si warm-up (yeh hamari misaal hai, kitab ki nahi). Farz kijiye kisi circuit mein \(R = 3\) ohm aur \(X = 4\) ohm hai. To \(Z = 3 + 4i\), aur kul rukawat \(|Z| = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\) ohm. Us ka angle \(\tan^{-1}(4/3) \approx 53.13^{\circ}\) hai, kyun ke \(R\) aur \(X\) dono positive hain aur point first quadrant mein hai. Polar form mein \(Z \approx 5(\cos 53.13^{\circ} + i\sin 53.13^{\circ})\). Bilkul yahi shakal kitab ki misaal mein impedance ki hai, sirf numbers mukhtalif hain.
Ab Example 17 mein hum dekhenge ke voltage aur impedance diye hon to current kaise nikalta hai. Sab se pehle yeh pehchaaniye ke kya diya hai aur kya maanga hai; phir formula chuniye.

blocks.title: Example 17
blocks.problem: If the impedance of circuit is \(11(\cos 55.35^{\circ} + i\sin 55.35^{\circ})\) ohms at a voltage of \(25(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ})\) V, find the value of current in the circuit.
steps:
Given: impedance \(Z = 11(\cos 55.35^{\circ} + i\sin 55.35^{\circ})\) ohms, aur voltage \(V = 25(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ})\) volts.
Find karna hai: current \(I\).
Tareeqa: sab se pehle sochiye kaun sa formula in teeno cheezon ko jodta hai: AC ke liye Ohm's law \(V = IZ\). Is se \(I = V/Z\). Dono numbers polar form mein diye gaye hain, is liye 1.3.3 wala quotient rule seedha lagega: moduli divide, angles tafreeq. Aakhir mein jawab ko rectangular form mein bhi likhenge.

V = IZ mein rakhiye
\[25(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ})\]
\[= I \cdot 11(\cos 55.35^{\circ} + i\sin 55.35^{\circ})\]
\[I = \dfrac{V}{Z}\]
Kyun: \(I\) ko akela karne ke liye dono taraf \(Z\) se divide kiya, bilkul waise jaise aam algebra mein \(6 = 2x\) se \(x = 6/2\) nikaalte hain.

Polar form mein divide kijiye
\[|I| = \dfrac{25}{11} \approx 2.2727\]
\[\theta = 30^{\circ} - 55.35^{\circ} = -25.35^{\circ}\]
\[I = 2.27[\cos(-25.35^{\circ}) + i\sin(-25.35^{\circ})]\]
Kyun: quotient rule \(\frac{r_1}{r_2}[\cos(\theta_1 - \theta_2) + i\sin(\theta_1 - \theta_2)]\). Upar wale (voltage) ka angle minus neeche wale (impedance) ka angle.
Dhyan dein: \(25/11 = 2.2727...\) ko abhi round mat kijiye; agle step mein poori value istemaal kijiye, warna aakhri jawab ka doosra decimal ghalat ho jaata hai.

Cosine aur sine nikaaliye
\[\cos(-25.35^{\circ}) = \cos 25.35^{\circ} \approx 0.9037\]
\[\sin(-25.35^{\circ}) = -\sin 25.35^{\circ} \approx -0.4281\]
Kyun: cosine even function hai, \(\cos(-A) = \cos A\), yaani negative angle se cos ki value nahi badalti. Sine odd function hai, \(\sin(-A) = -\sin A\), yaani sign ulat jaata hai. Calculator ko degree mode mein rakh kar values nikaaliye.

Rectangular form mein likhiye
\[\text{Re} = 2.2727 \times 0.9037 \approx 2.054\]
\[\text{Im} = 2.2727 \times (-0.4281) \approx -0.973\]
\[I \approx 2.05 - 0.97i\]
Kyun: \(r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta) = r\cos\theta + i\,r\sin\theta\), is liye modulus ko cos se multiply kar ke real part aur sin se multiply kar ke imaginary part milta hai. Kitab ne \(2.27\), \(0.90\) aur \(0.42\) pehle hi round kar diye, is liye us ka jawab \(2.04 - 0.95i\) doosre decimal mein thoda ghalat hai.

Kitab ki aakhri line
Kitab aakhir mein "Thus, current is \(6 - 4.21i\)" likhti hai. Yeh us ke apne upar wale hisaab se bilkul mel nahi khaata; yeh printing ki ghalti hai. Sahi current \(I \approx 2.05 - 0.97i\) hai (neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye).

Tasdeeq
Wapas multiply kar ke dekhiye: \(|I| \cdot |Z| = 2.2727 \times 11 = 25\) aur \(-25.35^{\circ} + 55.35^{\circ} = 30^{\circ}\). Is liye \(IZ = 25(\cos 30^{\circ} + i\sin 30^{\circ}) = V\). Bilkul wahi voltage wapas mil gaya.
Rectangular form mein bhi: \(Z \approx 6.254 + 9.049i\), aur
\[(2.054 - 0.973i)(6.254 + 9.049i)\]
\[\approx 21.65 + 12.50i\]
jo \(25\cos 30^{\circ} + i\,25\sin 30^{\circ}\) hi hai. Sahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Example 17: kitab ki aakhri line "Thus, current is \(6 - 4.21i\)" chhaapti hai, jo us ke apne hisaab se nahi nikalti. Us se pehli line \(2.04 - 0.95i\) bhi thodi ghalat hai, kyun ke \(2.27\), \(0.90\) aur \(0.42\) bohat pehle round kar diye gaye. \(25/11 = 2.2727\), \(\cos 25.35^{\circ} = 0.9037\) aur \(\sin 25.35^{\circ} = 0.4281\) lene se current yeh hai:
\[I \approx 2.05 - 0.97i \text{ A}\]
(modulus \(2.27\) A, angle \(-25.35^{\circ}\)).
Kitab ke hal mein \(\cos 30^{\circ} + I\sin 30^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 55.35^{\circ} + I\sin 55.35^{\circ}\) mein bara "I" bhi chhapa hai; wahan us ka matlab \(i\) (iota) hai, current nahi.

Ab doosri jagah. Cryptography woh ilm hai jis mein paighaam ko mehfooz kiya jaata hai: ek parhne ke qaabil paighaam (plaintext) ko riyazi qawaaid (algorithms) aur keys ki madad se khufia code (ciphertext) mein badal dete hain. Is ke do bunyaadi hisse hain:
• encryption: maths aur key se paighaam ko "taala" lagana;
• decryption: sahi key se woh taala dobara kholna.
Aap roz isay istemaal karte hain bina jaane: WhatsApp messages, bank ATM aur online payments sab encryption se mehfooz hote hain. Kitab ki misaal mein key ek complex number hai, aur taala kholne ke liye us ka multiplicative inverse chahiye.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Misaal shuru karne se pehle yaad kijiye: kisi complex number \(k\) ka multiplicative inverse \(k^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{k}\) hai, aur isay nikaalne ke liye upar neeche conjugate se multiply karte hain. Short formula: \(k^{-1} = \overline{k}/|k|^2\). Yahi is misaal ki "chaabi" hai.

blocks.title: Example 18
blocks.problem:
The word "MATH" is to be encrypted by multiplying a complex number \(k = 2 + 3i\) and then decrypted back to its original form using the concept of multiplicative inverse in complex numbers.
Each letter of the alphabet is assigned a numerical value as follows: A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, ..., Z = 26.
steps:
Given: lafz MATH, harfon ki values A = 1, ..., Z = 26, aur key \(k = 2 + 3i\).
Find karna hai: encrypted numbers, aur yeh dikhana ke decryption se MATH wapas mil jaata hai.
Tareeqa: encryption ka matlab hai har number ko \(k\) se multiply karna. Decryption us ka ulta kaam hai: \(k\) se divide karna, yaani \(k\) ke multiplicative inverse \(k^{-1}\) se multiply karna. Multiplicative inverse woh number hai jis se multiply karne par 1 aaye.

Harfon ko complex numbers banaiye
M = 13, A = 1, T = 20, H = 8, is liye
\[z = 13 + 0i,\ 1 + 0i,\ 20 + 0i,\ 8 + 0i\]
Kyun: har harf ko aisa complex number banaya jis ka imaginary part zero hai. Real number bhi complex number hi hai (\(b = 0\) wala), is liye ab isay complex key se multiply kar sakte hain.

Encrypt: k se multiply kijiye
\[(13 + 0i)(2 + 3i) = 26 + 39i\]
\[(1 + 0i)(2 + 3i) = 2 + 3i\]
\[(20 + 0i)(2 + 3i) = 40 + 60i\]
\[(8 + 0i)(2 + 3i) = 16 + 24i\]
Kyun: real number \(n\) ko \(2 + 3i\) se multiply karne par \(2n + 3ni\) aata hai; dono parts \(n\) guna ho jaate hain. Misaal: \(13 \times 2 = 26\) aur \(13 \times 3 = 39\).

k ka multiplicative inverse nikaaliye
\[k^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{2 + 3i} \cdot \dfrac{2 - 3i}{2 - 3i}\]
\[= \dfrac{2 - 3i}{4 + 9} = \dfrac{2 - 3i}{13}\]
Kyun: \(k \cdot k^{-1} = 1\) hona chahiye. Denominator mein \(i\) nahi rehna chahiye, is liye conjugate \(2 - 3i\) se upar neeche multiply kiya: \((2 + 3i)(2 - 3i) = 4 - 9i^2 = 4 + 9 = 13\), jo real hai.

M ko decrypt kijiye
\[\dfrac{26 + 39i}{2 + 3i} = \dfrac{(26 + 39i)(2 - 3i)}{13}\]
\[(26 + 39i)(2 - 3i)\]
\[= 52 - 78i + 78i - 117i^2\]
\[= 52 + 117 = 169\]
\[\dfrac{169}{13} = 13 \;\Rightarrow\; \text{M}\]
Kyun: \(k\) se divide karna \(k^{-1}\) se multiply karna hai. \(-78i\) aur \(+78i\) kat gaye, aur \(-117i^2 = +117\) bana kyun ke \(i^2 = -1\). 13 ka harf M hai.

A, T, H ko decrypt kijiye
Har encrypted number asal mein \(2 + 3i\) ka real multiple hai:
\[2 + 3i = 1(2 + 3i) \Rightarrow 1 = \text{A}\]
\[40 + 60i = 20(2 + 3i) \Rightarrow 20 = \text{T}\]
\[16 + 24i = 8(2 + 3i) \Rightarrow 8 = \text{H}\]
Kyun: \(\dfrac{n(2 + 3i)}{2 + 3i} = n\); jo cheez multiply hui thi woh divide hote hi kat jaati hai. Yeh shortcut lamba multiplication bachata hai, lekin M wala poora tareeqa bhi har harf ke liye chalega.

Tasdeeq
Decrypt hone wali values \(13, 1, 20, 8\) se harf M, A, T, H bante hain, yaani asal lafz wapas mil gaya. Kitab ki table (neeche) mein bhi yahi nataij hain.
blocks.answer: Encrypted: M \(\to 26 + 39i\), A \(\to 2 + 3i\), T \(\to 40 + 60i\), H \(\to 16 + 24i\). Har ek ko \(k = 2 + 3i\) se divide karne par \(13, 1, 20, 8\) wapas milte hain, yaani MATH.

blocks.caption: Table (kitab wali, brackets theek kar ke): k = 2 + 3i se MATH ki encryption aur decryption

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab ki table mein T aur H wali rows mein key ke gird bracket chhoot gaye hain: kitab \((40 + 60i) / 2 + 3i = 20 + 0i\) aur \(16 + 24i / 2 + 3i = 8 + 0i\) chhaapti hai. Agar isay lafzi taur par parhein to \((40 + 60i)/2 + 3i\) ka matlab \(20 + 33i\) ban jaata hai. Sahi yeh hai:
\[\dfrac{40 + 60i}{2 + 3i} = 20 + 0i\]
\[\dfrac{16 + 24i}{2 + 3i} = 8 + 0i\]
Upar ki table mein humne brackets laga diye hain. Baaqi table ke saare numbers sahi hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh tareeqa kaam kyun karta hai? \(k\) se multiply kar ke phir \(k\) se divide karna ek doosre ko mita deta hai, kyun ke \(k \cdot k^{-1} = 1\). Jaise darwaaze ko chaabi se band kar ke usi chaabi se khol diya. Isi liye key \(0\) nahi ho sakti: \(0\) ka koi multiplicative inverse nahi (zero se divide nahi hota), yaani taala lag jaayega lekin khulega kabhi nahi.
Jis shakhs ke paas sirf \(26 + 39i, 2 + 3i, \ldots\) hain, woh \(k\) jaane baghair lafz nahi parh sakta. Asal cryptography is se kahin zyada mazboot maths istemaal karti hai, lekin key aur us ke inverse ka bunyaadi idea yahi hai.
Khud sochiye: \(k = 2 + 3i\) se lafz "CAB" ka pehla harf C (= 3) encrypt kijiye. (Jawab: \(3(2 + 3i) = 6 + 9i\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
• DC: \(V = IR\). AC: \(V = IZ\), jahan impedance \(Z = R + iX\) aur reactance \(X = X_L - X_C\).
• \(|Z| = \sqrt{R^2 + X^2}\) kul rukawat hai; polar form mein \(I = V/Z\) ek polar division hai (moduli divide, angles tafreeq).
• Calculator ki poori values aakhri step tak rakhiye; sirf final jawab round kijiye.
• Yahan encryption: \(k\) se multiply. Decryption: \(k\) se divide (yaani \(k^{-1} = \overline{k}/|k|^2\) se multiply).
• Key kabhi \(0\) nahi ho sakti.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
• Angles ulti taraf se tafreeq karna: \(I = V/Z\) ka angle \(\theta_V - \theta_Z = 30^{\circ} - 55.35^{\circ}\) hai, \(55.35^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\) nahi.
• \(25/11\), \(\cos\) aur \(\sin\) ko multiply karne se pehle do digits tak round kar dena: jawab ka doosra decimal ghalat ho jaata hai.
• Angles degrees mein hon aur calculator radian mode mein: bilkul ghalat values aati hain.
• \(\sin(-A)\) ka minus bhool jaana; \(\cos(-A) = \cos A\) lekin \(\sin(-A) = -\sin A\).
• \(a + bi / c + di\) bina brackets ke likhna; hamesha \((a + bi)/(c + di)\) likhiye.
